name: FOFO
intro: 本文提出了FOFO，一个开创性的基准，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）遵循复杂、特定领域格式的能力，这是它们作为AI代理应用的一个关键但未被充分研究的能力。FOFO通过AI与人类协作的方法，开发了多样的真实世界格式和指令，填补了现有基准在评估格式遵循能力方面的空白。
org: Salesforce Research, University of Illinois at Chicago, Pennsylvania State University
build_method: 专家领域种子与GPT-4扩展, 专用格式生成与人工复核, FORMAT-INSTRU生成与逐条核验
task_type: 格式化文本生成, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 缺少任一格式要求即失败, GPT-4二元判断与解释, 100题人工一致性复核
build_method_en: Expert Domain Seeds plus GPT-4 Expansion, Domain-format Generation and Human Review, FORMAT-INSTRU Generation and Per-item Verification
eval_feature_en: Any Missing Format Requirement Fails, GPT-4 Binary Verdict plus Explanation, 100-item Human Agreement Check
intro_en: This paper introduces FOFO, a pioneering benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLM) ability to follow complex, domain-specific formats—a critical yet underexplored capability for their use as AI agents. FOFO employs AI-human collaboration to develop diverse real-world formats and instructions, addressing the gap in existing benchmarks for assessing format adherence.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.18667 Section 3, Tables 1-3, and Appendix A. Experts seed useful agent subdomains, GPT-4 expands and groups them, and iterative human review yields 10 domains with five subdomains each. GPT-4 proposes five human-readable text formats per subdomain while initially excluding generic formats; experts regenerate or remove poor proposals, then universal JSON/XML/CSV/Markdown/YAML formats are added back, giving 248 formats. GPT-4 writes detailed FORMAT-INSTRU for each selected domain/subdomain/format triplet with exact configurations and dummy context; humans edit, remove, or regenerate each item. The final 494 instructions average 2,908 characters. Models generate with their official prompt formats, temperature 0.7, and 5,120 max new tokens. GPT-4 returns a binary verdict and explanation; missing any single requirement fails. Human review agrees on 84/100 judgments and reveals all 16 disagreements are GPT-4 false positives.
